data.name: Qaif
data.gender_notes: Qaif is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is restless and wandering, a traveler, a seeker of knowledge. The name Qaif carries the meaning “Struggle, Journey” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qaif usually hope their child will grow to embody struggle, journey and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes a person on a spiritual journey, seeking enlightenment and knowledge
data.etymology: Qaif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Struggle, Journey.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qaif total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Qaif holds an important place in Islamic history, as it is the name of a significant figure – Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib, the fourth caliph of the Islamic Ummah and a famous scholar. "Qaif al-Jassas" is a famous book of Hadith compiled by Abul Abbas Ahmad ibn Ali Al-Qasimi, which has had a profound impact on Islamic education and scholars for centuries. The name "Qaif" can also be associated with the concept of the Sufi "Qawwali," a form of Islamic traditional music that often involves spiritual poetry, invoking a deep connection with the divine and emotional unity among the listeners.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name "Qaif" emphasizes the idea of a restless soul in constant search of knowledge and truth. This name resonates with those embarked on journeys of self-discovery, aiming to seek knowledge, understanding, and enlightenment. The name may serve as a reminder for individuals to not rest on their accomplishments but to continually dedicate themselves to their personal and spiritual development.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Struggle, Journey" symbolizes One who is restless and wandering, a traveler, a seeker of knowledge. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Qaif serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of struggle, journey.
